response.sql:
WITH transaction_trader_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    t.tradekind,
    COUNT(*) as ab_count
  FROM advancedbehavior ab
  INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
  INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(ab_count) as total FROM transaction_trader_counts
),
with_share AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.*,
    t1.ab_count::float / t2.total as share
  FROM transaction_trader_counts t1
  CROSS JOIN total_count t2
),
trader_type_summary AS (
  SELECT 
    tradekind,
    AVG(ab_count) as avg_count,
    AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM with_share
  GROUP BY tradekind
)
SELECT * FROM trader_type_summary
ORDER BY tradekind;

assumptions.assumption: "Share of the overall total" refers to each transaction's advanced-behavior count divided by the sum of all advanced-behavior counts across all matched transactions (global share), not share within each trader type.

alternatives.interpretation: The request asks for the intermediate results: for each (transaction, trader_type) pair, show the count and global share before averaging by trader_type.
